description: Every NFC_Quick_Check value normalizes aliases through terminals, tests, patterns, conditions, filters, and caller tags.
grammar:
%rule text r0 r1 r2
%rule r0 $x:_NFC_Quick_Check_Maybe<_NFC_Quick_Check_Maybe>
%conditions $x ≅ #_NFC_Quick_Check_Maybe<_NFC_Quick_Check_Maybe>, _NFC_Quick_Check_Maybe ⊆ $x.tags
%emits $x :: $x.tags ∩ _NFC_Quick_Check_Maybe
%rule r1 $x:_NFC_Quick_Check_No<_NFC_Quick_Check_No>
%conditions $x ≅ #_NFC_Quick_Check_No<_NFC_Quick_Check_No>, _NFC_Quick_Check_No ⊆ $x.tags
%emits $x :: $x.tags ∩ _NFC_Quick_Check_No
%rule r2 $x:_NFC_Quick_Check_Yes<_NFC_Quick_Check_Yes>
%conditions $x ≅ #_NFC_Quick_Check_Yes<_NFC_Quick_Check_Yes>, _NFC_Quick_Check_Yes ⊆ $x.tags
%emits $x :: $x.tags ∩ _NFC_Quick_Check_Yes
